body: Nothing in the UI reads message['decryptionFailed'] — only ChatEngine writes it and homePreviewTextLocked reads it. That is why a failed row draws as a blank bubble instead of a cannot-decrypt state, and why Home and the transcript disagree. The render fix belongs in ChatListViewCells.swift, which agent 01a03dd9 (grok, video-note UI) currently owns.
